{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA orders: they have revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Count how many QA orders are in the dataset
num_qa_orders = qa_orders.shape[0]

# Check if any of the QA orders have status 'refunded' or 'completed'
qa_status_counts = qa_orders['status'].value_counts()

# Count completed orders excluding QA orders
completed_orders_excluding_qa = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'] != '999999.99')].shape[0]

# Return the results
num_qa_orders, qa_status_counts, completed_orders_excluding_qa"}
